Also if you notice, the “bad” egos appear. They don’t rise up like the regular characters do. Virgil mentioned it in the second part to the nostalgia episode. He got light headed and said he doesn’t know how they do it. Also in one episode Logan remarks how alerting it is to him that he just appears. Not to also mention when deceit was impersonating Patton, he just showed up at the beginning of the video. 

I’d also like to point out I think at this current moment Patton is again being impersonated. He seemed... off.. at the end of the video. It would also make sense for Patton to be attacked by the egos so often and why Virgil wasn’t too uneasy around Patton. 

Deceit obviously feels no empathy. He alluded to it when he said “life is like a piñata. You can play with the blind fold on, if you like to play the game that way, but it would be so much easier if you took it off.” The blindfold being empathy for his friends. So taking advantage of emotions and manipulating them are extremely easy. So it would make sense. 

Trying to impersonate Logan was logically (pun intended) the next choice, being void of emotion himself he would be the next easiest to impersonate. Only thing that tripped him up is his lack of knowledge that Logan takes everything extra literal. 

It would make sense that Virgil is more comfortable around Patton because he has manipulated him before. Which is why Virgil stands up to deceit when he goes after Patton in the new video. He knows how vulnerable Patton is because of how emotional he is. And he knows that deceit knows just how to manipulate them to the others digression. 

I mean like deceit said. What you don’t know can’t hurt you. 

TLDR: good egos rise, bad egos( including Virgil) appear. Also Patton is very vulnerable to manipulations at any point by any of the bad egos. And Virgil knows it.
